hardening.renderReady: Archive/Mixer mark RENDER_READY only after renderBody succeeds; all three adapters store failure evidence and resolve a failed render outcome otherwise.
hardening.printGate: Archive/Mixer/Clinic assert a successful render outcome before PRINT_READY or any selected transport.
hardening.imageReady: Archive/Mixer/Clinic wait for every rendered image and reject load error, decode error, zero dimensions, or timeout before IMAGE_READY.
negativeTests: intentional render failure blocks RENDER_READY and PRINT_READY

printReady: PRINT_READY is marked only immediately before the already-selected browser/raster/native/GDI transport; no print dialog was opened during browser verification.
